note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(地球/环保主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: A small island once had clear blue water and plenty of fish. After a busy factory opened nearby, waste leaked into the sea, and most of the fish soon disappeared. The villagers worked together to clean the water, and a few years later the fish slowly came back.

questions.q: What happened soon after the factory opened?
options: The island suddenly got many more fish.
The sea water became much cleaner.
Waste polluted the sea and the fish vanished.
The factory closed down at once.
questions.explanation: 原文 'waste leaked into the sea, and most of the fish soon disappeared' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did the fish finally come back?
options: The villagers cleaned the water together.
The factory gave the island new fish.
People bought fish from a faraway city.
Nothing at all was done about it.
questions.explanation: 末句 'The villagers worked together to clean the water' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
